chunks: Bakr ibn Muḥammad al-Azdī narrated from Abū Baṣīr, from him, peace be upon him, that he said:

If a man swears that he will not rub his nose against a wall, Allah, the Exalted, will test him until he rubs his nose against the wall. And if a man swears that he will not strike his head against the wall, Allah, the Mighty and Majestic, will assign a devil to him until he strikes his head against the wall.

key_terms.الْحَائِطِ: the wall mentioned in the example

ai.seo_question: What does this hadith teach about swearing oaths over trivial matters?
ai.summary: This hadith warns against making unnecessary and stubborn oaths over trivial matters. It teaches that a person may be tried through the very thing he arrogantly swears to avoid, showing the danger of careless speech and reliance on oneself instead of Allah.
